the system-wide and local algorithms are feasible and could work as decision making support for system operators in dealing with cascading event.
the proposed detection tools could be implemented in real power systems to help the operator in detecting and preventing cascading events, and thus improving the power system security.
a new framework of detection tools for disturbances and relay operations leading to cascade events is developed.
In summary, our research is concerned with
detection of the power system cascading events, which is an important step towards prevention of the cascading blackouts.
the development of the system-wide and local detection algorithms and the data requirements for these algorithms, and the implementation of these algorithms through integration of SCADA and IEDs.
the development of detection tools for disturbances and protection relay operations leading to a cascading event.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed system is feasible to be implemented and could work as a powerful decision making tool for operators to prevent cascading events.
a system-wide and local cascading detection algorithm is feasible, and the implementation could be achieved with existing monitoring and control tools.
the proposed system-wide monitoring and control tool is a powerful and effective means for detecting and preventing cascading outages.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the cascading event detection is feasible by using the proposed algorithms, but it is not easy to implement in real power systems.
a new system-wide monitoring and protection scheme could be developed by integrating the existing SCADA and IED technologies.

a system-wide and sub-station-wide monitoring and control system can be implemented in the real-time environment, which could provide valuable information to the system operators for decision-making support.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the cascading event detection tools should be based on a combination of systemwide and local substation-wide tools.

a cascading outage detection system should be able to integrate the system-wide and local information, and the detection system should be designed to work with the current monitoring and control system.

a combination of the system-wide and local detection algorithms is necessary for detecting the cascading event and the local detection algorithms are more reliable than system-wide ones in most cases.
